## What landed

**Data.** `exports/src/exports/data/known_issues.toml` (`sig.known-issues/1`)
— the committed curated registry: `issue_id`, `source_id`, `issue_class`
(closed curated vocabulary), `opened_at`/`closed_at` UTC instants,
`status`, `correction_ref`, `text` + `text_state`. Seeded with the eight
F-322 geometry-defect groups (`axis_swap` ×2, `wrong_jurisdiction` ×4,
`null_island` ×2) recorded by `sig.geometry-corrections/1` — all `open`,
all `pending_review` (D-J3-12).

**Emit.** `exports/src/exports/known_issues.py` — fail-closed loader +
validator (`KnownIssuesError` on a bad schema/class/status/date/text
contract or a duplicate id) + `curated_issue_records` (pending text
dropped). `exports/transparency.py`: `issue_records` gains `known_issues`
(auto rows carry `kind="auto"`; curated rows merge beside them);
`ISSUE_RECORD_FIELDS` + `issue_specs` gain `kind`, `text`, `text_state`,
`correction_ref`; `emit_transparency_artifacts` loads the packaged toml
by default (`known_issues`/`known_issues_path` seams, `_UNSET` posture
matching `source_registry`/`cadence_sources`).

**Lane.** `ops/status_lane.py`: `build_status_lane(known_issues=…)` —
`lane["issues"]["curated"]` carries the listed sources' curated rows only
(S-11 count-only states never named); `status_issues_index_html` renders
the curated log table (open/closed, opened_at, interim marker, ref).
`ops/status_publish.emit_status_tree` + `sig-ops status-publish
--known-issues` wire the packaged file through.

**Web.** `web/src/lib/issues.ts` — the `sig.source-issue/1` seam
(export mode reads `transparency/issues.jsonl` fail-loud on malformed,
honest `[]` on absent; fixtures exercise every state) + `ISSUES_FIXTURE`,
class labels, per-source grouping, the pending-review interim text.
`web/src/pages/status/issues/index.astro` — T1 page grouped per source
(status-clock label, figure-wrapped open/closed/curated counts).
`web/src/pages/sources/[id]/index.astro` — the "Known issues" section.
`page-types.ts` — `/status/issues/` T1/`sig.source-issue/1`. `status-lane.ts`
— `issues.curated` optional field mirrored.

**Tests.** `tests/exports/test_known_issues.py` (7 — load/validate/F-322
seed/pending-drop/confirmed-flow/bad rows/merge/append-only) ·
`tests/ops/test_status_lane.py` (+3 — lane carries listed-only curated,
count-only drop, HTML render incl. no-`<script>`) ·
`web/tests/unit/issues.test.ts` (8) · `tests/unit/test_p36_49_copy_batch.py`
